subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate text-plus-voice messages, and should that policy live under global `messages.tts` or Telegram/channel-specific config?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but the fix adds public configuration and overlaps with captioned-final and voice-only TTS directions, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Define a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Add a backward-compatible delivery mode with documented captioned and separate behavior, then implement focused Telegram tests and live proof.

options.title: Standardize captioned delivery
options.body: Keep captioned voice as the supported Telegram behavior and document tagged/manual splitting plus overflow fallback instead of adding config.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final lands
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 or its replacement to settle before deciding whether a separate-delivery selector still belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Add a backward-compatible delivery mode with documented captioned and separate behavior, then implement focused Telegram tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans TTS core config and Telegram delivery policy, where the history points most strongly to steipete's TTS and caption delivery work.
